[Intro: house piano chords, finger snaps, organ swell]

[Verse 1: warm soulful female alto]
Bad news runs, it kicks the door
Three a.m., it's on the floor
Good news likes to take its time
Stops for coffee, waits in line

[Chorus: full soulful house groove, small choir]
Good news travels slow
But it gets here, oh, it gets here
Good news travels slow
Took the long road all year
Phone lit up at noon, and now I know

[Verse 2: voice lifting, handclaps]
I kept the ringer loud for weeks
Slept with the phone against my cheek
Then here, wet hands, the midday sun
One short line: it's good, it's done

[Chorus: full soulful house groove, small choir]
Good news travels slow
But it gets here, oh, it gets here
Good news travels slow
Took the long road all year
Phone lit up at noon, and now I know
Good news travels slow

(It gets here) Wait on it
(It gets here) Don't you quit
(It gets here) Every bit

[Outro: piano, choir humming, a splash, laughing]
